Mask.name: Mask
Mask.description: Shadowkhan Oni Mask. Mask powers continuously generate corresponding Shadowkhan cards during combat.
Shadowkhan.name: Shadowkhan
Shadowkhan.description: Shadowkhan cards are Exhausted by default. Their damage and Block are affected by Dominion instead of Strength/Dexterity.
Dominion.name: Dominion
Dominion.description: Shadowkhan cards are no longer affected by Strength or Dexterity. Instead, each stack of Dominion increases their damage or Block by 1.
Curse.name: Curse
Curse.description: The target is cursed. When Curse stacks >= target's current HP, instantly kill the target. Some Shadowkhan cards gain extra effects based on Curse stacks (e.g. Blade-khan deals +25% damage, Bat-khan heals HP).
Dark Hand.name: Dark Hand
Dark Hand.description: Dark Hand series cards. Some effects apply or use Blackhand marks.
Blackhand.name: Blackhand
Blackhand.description: A mark applied by Dark Hand cards. Some Dark Hand cards gain extra effects based on stacks and can consume those stacks.
Ah Fu Move.name: Ah Fu Move
Ah Fu Move.description: Powerful moves performed by the Dark Hand's general, Ah Fu.
Ah Fu Combo.name: Ah Fu Combo
Ah Fu Combo.description: If the last card played this turn was an Ah Fu Move, trigger an additional effect.
Flight.name: Flight
Flight.description: Reduces the next damage taken by half.
Dark Warrior.name: Dark Warrior
Dark Warrior.description: Dark Warrior series cards serving Daolon Wong.
Animal Talisman.name: Animal Talisman
Animal Talisman.description: Twelve Zodiac Animal Talisman cards. Rare and powerful talisman magic.
